acceptance.output_evidence: THE READING, in three parts, each with the measurement it rests on. (1) THREE OWNERS? Counted, not assumed: over 21 owned rows the distribution is 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp 14, 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps 6, 3.0.0_SA_CVO 1, and the split is NOT by carrier -- owner is a function of the QUESTION. Every cadence row is CloudOps' because all three carriers ride one clock pair (producer cron(0 3 * * ? *), archiving derive cron(0 2 * * ? *)); every location row is CloudOps' because all three live in one bucket; methodology, persistence, key and failure-mode are CloudComp's on all three because every remedy is producer code; one row breaks the pattern, the edges coverage row, whose population is the CVO's own S96/S97 measurement. So the premise as literally stated is REFUTED and the rule it rests on is confirmed by a stronger case: Rule 24(iv) says REMEDIES do not move together, not that owners must differ, and here ONE seat holds three remedies with three clocks that demonstrably did not move together -- cycle 3's props fix did not touch the edges, cycle 4's edges fix did not touch the nodes, and the nodes remedy still does not exist. A single-subject card would have read 'CloudComp owns the carry-forward', been true, and closed. (2) A FOURTH CARRIER: the real candidate is EDGE ATTRIBUTES -- the props remedy visits nodes only and the edges remedy removes whole edges by type, so nothing inspects a carried edge's attributes; an attribute retired on an edge is in the state the vocabulary stamp was in before cycle 3, and worse, because the node case was caught by a served COUNT that has no edge-attribute equivalent. Node and edge DELETION is named too but it is the same carrier's failure mode rather than a new carrier, and saying so is a claim a reader can reject. The honest answer is a warning about the method: nothing enumerates carriers, so a fourth will be found the way the first three were -- by an instance -- unless someone derives the carrier list from the producer's emission surface. (3) WHAT IT OBLIGES: never read an absence from this producer as a retirement without checking the drop-on-read for that carrier (safe for STORED_IN, safe for the one enumerated prop key, unsafe everywhere else); name the carrier when quoting a count; any new emission arrives with a counted drop-on-read or with a declared reason its emission can never shrink; never certify a shrink by counting the artifact, because under the archive read the artifact count equals the prior cycle's; and cite the vintage, because slot ~1 is editing the producer in this same round.
